dashboard.pwa_title: Mobile App (PWA) NFC How to Use & Cautions
dashboard.pwa_desc: NFC Issuance & Stable Background Operation Guide
dashboard.pwa_guide_text:
1. Please make sure that NFC on the top bar of your Android smartphone is activated in "Default Mode (Read/Write)".
2. Installing and running this page as an app (PWA) on the Home screen allows more stable operation without background disconnection.

dashboard.guide_title: Genuine Verification Tag (NFC) Registration & Shipment Process Guide
dashboard.step1_desc: Create a genuine certificate catalog by registering specification information such as serial number, weight, purity, and manufacturing date of the gold bar.
dashboard.step1_desc_html: Create a genuine certificate catalog by registering specification information such as serial number, weight, purity, and manufacturing date of the gold bar.
dashboard.step2_desc: Scan and map the unique UID of the physical NFC tag, and connect it with the catalog so that the data can be reflected on the tag.
dashboard.step2_desc_html: Scan and map the unique UID of the physical NFC tag, and connect it with the catalog so that the data can be reflected on the tag.
dashboard.step3_desc: Register the genuine certificate URL at the time of shipment to complete the final shipment process. Users can connect directly to the web certificate when scanning the tag.
dashboard.step3_desc_html: Register the genuine certificate URL at the time of shipment to complete the final shipment process. Users can connect directly to the web certificate when scanning the tag.
